deployments_detail.use: "CoreAI" — AI layer across the group connecting all enterprise knowledge into an "intelligent system"; EUR 300M three-year investment (own press release)

CoreAI — group-wide AI platform (launched Jan 2024) unifying 2.3bn consumer profiles, ~1PB of Marcel content and Publicis Sapient's code/data to power insight, media, creation/production, software and operations for 100,000+ employees. Backed by a €300M/3-year investment; uses Microsoft cloud and Nvidia chips. [Microsoft, Nvidia]
deployments_detail.value: €300M invested over 3 years; 2.3bn consumer profiles; ~1PB data; 100,000+ employees

deployments_detail.use: Sapient Bodhi — platform to deploy and scale secure, enterprise-grade AI agents across operations, commerce, marketing and customer engagement (incl. ML Ops), used to connect agents to e-commerce/CRM/ERP/inventory and secure data exchange in client engagements.
Publicis Sapient + AWS five-year strategic collaboration to build and scale generative-AI-driven digital business transformation solutions for enterprise clients. [AWS]
G42 + Publicis Sapient AI-first services joint venture (MoU) to deliver enterprise AI adoption via sovereign infrastructure and industry expertise for the UAE and Global South. [G42]

Marcel — AI-powered internal productivity/collaboration platform (Daily Six, Expert Match, Open Brief) connecting the global workforce for knowledge-sharing, staffing and content, using Cortana-powered voice/video analysis and predictive analytics. [Microsoft (Azure, Cortana)]

Microsoft 365 Copilot enterprise rollout — Publicis deployed M365 Copilot to all 114,000+ employees worldwide for workforce productivity, with Azure as preferred cloud, as part of the expanded Microsoft partnership. [Microsoft (M365 Copilot, Azure)]

Sapient Slingshot — AI software-engineering platform that connects the full SDLC (strategy, design, build, deploy) via a real-time context graph, with intelligent assistants for developers/PMs/designers, automated coding, docs and testing, and AI agents that modernize legacy code (e.g. COBOL conversion). Deployed for global banks, healthcare providers and government agencies in Saudi Arabia and Dubai.

Sapient Sustain — agentic AI platform for enterprise IT operations built on an enterprise context graph (tickets, logs, systems); uses multi-agent orchestration, self-healing workflows and predictive models to detect and resolve incidents. Live with Nissan.
deployments_detail.value: Nissan: 40% lower operational costs, 62% same-day issue resolution (+72%), 80% shift to proactive ops, 99.99% uptime

deployments_detail.use: Agentic marketing full-stack platform with Microsoft — unifying legacy systems, AI agents and identity data; integrates Microsoft Copilot Studio, Agent 365 and Epsilon identity data on Microsoft Fabric so AI agents can act on proprietary data across marketing, commerce and customer engagement. [Microsoft (Copilot Studio, Agent 365, Fabric, Azure), Epsilon]

'Agentic Ready' offer (Performics + Publicis Sapient) — helps brands adapt to conversational/transactional AI agents via GEO Ready (visibility to AI), Feed Ready (AI-consumable product feeds) and Infra Ready (connecting AI agents to commerce/CRM/ERP via Bodhi) so AI agents can search, recommend and buy products.
